key_finding: NO image-based electronic/analog waveform VQA dataset exists on ANY of the three sources (HF / GitHub / arXiv). The closest domain match is WaveformQA (arXiv 2607.20638) but it is TEXT-based (VCD/event-time JSON) over DIGITAL waveforms, not images — usable as related-work + methodology reference, not directly as our image benchmark. No oscilloscope-screenshot QA, no SPICE-analog-waveform image VQA, no signal-chart-understanding image dataset was found. Conclusion (wake#855, HF-only) is now validated and extended across all 3 sources.

eda_waveform_specific_NEW_WAKE860.modality: TEXT (VCD traces + event-time JSON), NOT images
eda_waveform_specific_NEW_WAKE860.paper: WaveformQA: Benchmarking LLM Temporal Reasoning on Digital Waveforms (arXiv 2607.20638, IEEE ICLAD 2026)
eda_waveform_specific_NEW_WAKE860.description: 360 questions across 8 difficulty categories evaluating LLM temporal reasoning over DIGITAL waveforms. Traces produced by RTL simulation of 5 open-source RISC-V cores. Questions/GT answers/eval harness live in a GitHub repo (repo NOT located via GitHub search API: 'WaveformQA' search returned only an unrelated 0-star log repo; author dcummingsTT has no public repos visible via API — repo may be private or under a different org). Shows event-time JSON representation improves LLM accuracy vs raw VCD.
eda_waveform_specific_NEW_WAKE860.waveform_suitability: RELATED-WORK ONLY - text-based (VCD/JSON) digital (binary) waveforms, NOT image-based analog waveforms. CANNOT be used directly for our image-based waveform-recognition task. HIGH value as: (1) SOTA related-work citation for our paper, (2) methodology reference (8-category QA template structure + event-time JSON insight), (3) source of waveform-semantics QA templates to adapt to image modality.
eda_waveform_specific_NEW_WAKE860.migration_plan: Adapt WaveformQA's 8-category QA structure (single-signal value, multi-signal correlation, event ordering, etc.) to image modality: render our ngspice analog waveforms as images, ask the same semantic question types but answered from the IMAGE instead of the VCD text. This bridges their text-grounded categories to our vision-grounded task.

conclusion: No ready-made IMAGE-BASED electronic/analog waveform VQA dataset exists on any of HF/GitHub/arXiv (validated across 3 sources in wake#860, extending wake#855's HF-only result). The single closest DOMAIN match is WaveformQA (arXiv 2607.20638, IEEE ICLAD 2026): 360 questions / 8 categories over DIGITAL waveforms — but it is TEXT-based (VCD/event-time JSON), not images, so it cannot serve as our vision benchmark. ChartQA/PlotQA/FigureQA/ChartBench/ChartX and the recent arXiv chart-VQA papers (ChartQAPro/ChartMind/ChartNet etc.) are all data-visualization charts (bar/line/pie), none electronic waveforms. The current approach of synthesizing analog waveforms with ngspice and creating image-based QA pairs remains the correct and only viable path for an image-grounded waveform-recognition benchmark.
recommendation: Continue with ngspice-based analog waveform image synthesis (validated: no off-the-shelf alternative exists). NEW actionable additions from wake#860: (1) Cite WaveformQA (arXiv 2607.20638) as the closest related-work benchmark and adapt its 8-category QA template structure (single-signal value / multi-signal correlation / event ordering) to our image modality — this strengthens our benchmark design and situates it in the literature; (2) adopt WaveformQA's finding that a structured intermediate representation (event-time JSON) helps LLMs — analog: consider whether a structured text hint alongside the image aids our 2B model; (3) ChartQA/ChartX (image+text, permissive licenses) are the best transfer-pretraining candidates for general chart/plot reading before waveform fine-tuning, if a chart-reading warmup is desired; (4) the ~1.3K oscilloscope ImageNet images are a marginal real-image supplement only.
